name: Final Zubagon Punch
main_effect: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, if that Digimon has 16000 DP or more, that Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.), ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.), and ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of your opponent's next turn.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.
